notes: «قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's own voice and not a link; his remark «وروى وكيع، هذا الحديث عن ثابت بن أبي صفية» cites the same route and adds no link

the full chain «حدثنا بذلك هناد وقتيبة قالا حدثنا وكيع عن ثابت بن أبي صفية» is written; the matn route continues through «قال قلت لأبي جعفر حدثك جابر» (Thabit asks Abu Ja'far, who answers «نعم»): Abu Ja'far and Jabir are named as the source and speaker of the report (rule 6), so they are read as links; this needs a ruling because they sit inside the saying rather than in a chain field
the Prophet is not a link
